decisions.reason: As a flagship organic extension very close to the firm's core salami capabilities and strategic direction, it is a product the firm can readily improve and is therefore unlikely to withdraw.

This organic poultry mini-salami snack remains close enough to the firm's established meat-specialty knowledge to be learnable and supportable, though the poultry/snacking niche makes it somewhat less certain than the flagship line.

A premium salami snack for sharing builds directly on the firm's existing recipes, processing know-how, and broad assortment strategy, so management would usually keep it and refine it rather than drop it quickly.
